channels.channel: sports shops and sports nutrition shops

companies.name: Supremefoodshop
channel_category: sports shops and sports nutrition shops
companies.distributes: Protein and energy bars, cookies, snacks, spreads and desserts from recognised sports nutrition brands such as BioTechUSA, Body Attack, Trec Nutrition, Powerstar Food and Best Body Nutrition
companies.channels_supplied: Its online shop for customers across Switzerland and its store at Cormanon Centre, Villars-sur-Glane
companies.fit_rationale: A Swiss sports nutrition shop that says it selects products from recognised brands and has bars, cookies, snacks and spreads categories, the closest match to Diablo's catalogue in this channel. It serves Geneva through its Swiss online shop; delivery area not stated on its website.
what_they_do_well: Runs both a physical store at Cormanon Centre and a Swiss online shop for sports nutrition.

companies.name: Rochat Cycles
channel_category: sports shops and sports nutrition shops
companies.distributes: Organic and vegan energy bars (Baouw) held in stock in its shops
companies.channels_supplied: Its own shops: Geneva (Rue du Perron), Geneva showroom, Aubonne road and MTB stores and Vevey
companies.sf_brands_carried: Baouw organic and vegan energy bars
companies.fit_rationale: A Lake Geneva bike retailer with a shop and a showroom in Geneva that stocks branded energy bars for cyclists in its shops. Diablo's vegan muesli bars fit next to the Baouw bars it already sells. No online shop is shown on its website.
what_they_do_well: Has served cyclists around Lake Geneva since 1998, now with five sites including two in Geneva.
Took over the former Cycles Colin store in Vevey.

companies.name: Alur Running Trail
channel_category: sports shops and sports nutrition shops
companies.distributes: Energy bars and sports nutrition from Naak, Overstims and Maurten
companies.channels_supplied: Its single running and trail store in Carouge, Geneva
companies.fit_rationale: A running and trail specialist in Carouge whose brand page lists a nutrition shelf with Naak, Overstims and Maurten, all bars and energy food bought from outside brands. Tier 3 because it is one shop with no online shop shown.
what_they_do_well: Offers gait analysis and sports podiatry alongside running brands such as Hoka, On and Asics.

companies.name: Bcyclet
channel_category: sports shops and sports nutrition shops
companies.distributes: Healthy snacks alongside bikes and cycling accessories
companies.channels_supplied: Its single bike store in Plan-les-Ouates, Geneva
companies.fit_rationale: A Geneva bike shop that names healthy snacks in its accessories range, the same kind of food shelf as Unihockey Center. Tier 3 because it is one shop, its snack brands are not named on its website and its online shop is still being built.
what_they_do_well: Carries premium cycling brands such as Colnago, Orbea, Apidura and Cafe du Cycliste.

companies.name: Swiss Snack Box
companies.distributes: Gift boxes of branded snacks: chocolate (Cailler), biscuits and pastries (Kambly, Kägi), crisps (Zweifel), sweet and savoury snacks and popcorn from Switzerland, Germany and the USA
companies.channels_supplied: Own online shop to shoppers and corporate clients, free delivery across Switzerland and shipping to Europe and Canada
companies.fit_rationale: A gift box company that buys full size packs from other brands such as Cailler, Kambly, Kägi and Zweifel and resells them in themed boxes, including to corporate clients. Small and founded in 2025, and its city and legal entity are not stated on its website. Storage: sells from its own stock, warehouse not named on its website; boxes are hand packed and dispatched from Switzerland.
what_they_do_well: Builds themed boxes of 10 full size snacks from known brands such as Cailler, Kambly and Zweifel.

companies.name: C'BONBONS
companies.distributes: Sweets: gummies, jelly sweets, sour sweets, vegan and sugar-free sweets and hard sweets from brands such as Ricola and Hitschies, plus candy gift boxes, mystery boxes and pick and mix sweets
companies.channels_supplied: Its own online shop delivering across Switzerland, plus Uber Eats delivery in Geneva
companies.sf_brands_carried: Sugar-free fruit jellies and Ricola sugar-free; the sugar-free jelly brand is not named on its website
companies.fit_rationale: A Geneva online sweet shop with over 400 references from other brands, including a sugar-free and a vegan section, and gift products such as bonbonnières and mystery boxes. Diablo's gummies, hard sweets and gift boxes match its range directly. It has no physical shop, so it is tier 3.
what_they_do_well: Offers over 400 sweet references with dedicated vegan and sugar-free sections.
Rated 4.5 out of 5 from 41 Trustpilot reviews.

companies.name: Confiserie Jellyfish
companies.distributes: Sweets from European makers: jelly sweets, wine gums, liquorice, toffees, hard sweets, sugar-free sweets and branded pastilles such as Leone and Vichy, sold for gifts and celebrations
companies.channels_supplied: Its own shop in Carouge, an online shop and sweet boxes for weddings, birthdays and corporate events
companies.sf_brands_carried: Sugar-free hard sweets listed; brands not named
companies.fit_rationale: An owner-run sweet shop in Carouge selling traditional sweets from France, England, the Netherlands and Switzerland, with a sugar-free line and gift boxes for Christmas, Easter and events. Diablo's sugar-free sweets and gift boxes fit its celebration and gifting trade. One shop plus online, so tier 3.
what_they_do_well: Builds custom sweet boxes for weddings, birthdays, baby showers and corporate events.
Stocks sweets from France, England, the Netherlands and Switzerland, including vegan and gluten-free options.
